visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a stacked tower of bread, featuring white, purple, and brown layers held by a person's hand. The background is a brightly lit bakery with wooden shelves and green branded boxes. (2) Hands tear open a small, round bun to reveal a bright yellow, creamy custard filling with a soft, steaming texture. (3) A female employee with brown hair, wearing a pink medical mask and a white coat over a blue shirt, stands in the store holding a paper bag containing bread. (4) The camera pans across a wooden table displaying various packaged bread items in clear bags with red logos, including a variety of flavors. (5) A series of close-up shots show hands pulling apart different types of toast: one with red bean and cream cheese, another with lemon custard, a purple one with blueberry jam, and a seeded one with cranberry and nuts. (6) The final shot shows the exterior of the bakery, 'True Bakery', through glass windows with a green circular logo and address text appearing as a screen overlay.

(2) A textured 'squish' and rustling sound of bread being torn marks a transition at 2 seconds, coinciding with a slight volume dip in BGM. (3) A brief interaction occurs at 7 seconds where a different female voice (bakery employee) speaks with a softer, polite tone explaining ingredients. (4) Digital 'whoosh' and 'pop' SFX are used at 15 seconds to accentuate visual transitions. (5) A clear 'ding' SFX sounds at 27 seconds as a new product variant is introduced. (6) The video concludes with the primary narrator's sign-off over a sustained, upbeat BGM tail.
